name: Raven-Oncall
description: A powerful on-call agent that runs experiments and jobs, then keeps watching them: it decides on its own when to look again, judges each round against the owner's goal, resubmits with better parameters, kills what went bad, and files a report. Use it whenever work must be run AND watched to an outcome -- a solver case, a training run, a parameter sweep. The signals: a budget, a shared machine, "tell me when it's done", or an answer that takes more than one round of runs to reach. Where the work sits is irrelevant: a remote box over ssh or a directory on this very computer both count. Tell it which machine the work runs on, in the owner's own words -- it resolves that against the machines they registered, and cannot ask them once the work has started. IMPORTANT: the spawn returns after the first turn, not when the job finishes.
owns: owns long-running or remote jobs that outlive this conversation. Do not run one yourself.
